components.note: 未 (not yet) — a tree 木 with a new short branch on top, still growing. Compare 末 mò (end/tip), where the top stroke is longer.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings: 情 emotion, 快 happy, 怕 afraid; 怜 is feeling pity.
令 (lìng) is a loose sound hint (lián/líng); same part in 铃 líng and 零 líng.
疒 (illness, 病字旁) — sickness and pain: 疼 ache, 痛 pain, 瘦 thin; here the word for illness itself.
丙 (bǐng) is a near sound match for bìng; also in 柄 bǐng handle.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — liquids and flow: 河, 汤, 酒; 治 first meant controlling water, then governing and curing.
台 (tái) is only a loose sound hint; the same part is in 始 shǐ and 胎 tāi.
疒 (illness, 病字旁) — sickness and healing: 病, 痛, 症; 疗 is to treat illness.
了 (liǎo) stands in for the sound of traditional 療 (liáo), close to liáo.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and speech: 说, 话, 请; here understanding what someone says.
京 (jīng) is only a loose sound hint; it also appears in 凉 liáng and 惊 jīng.
车 (cart, simplified 車) — vehicles and transport: 转 turn, 输 transport; compare 轻 light.
交 (jiāo) is close to jiào; also in 校 xiào and 胶 jiāo.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 给, 线; 组 is to weave threads together, so to form a group.
且 (qiě) loosely hints at zǔ; 组 sounds exactly like 祖 zǔ and 阻 zǔ, same part.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 给, 线; here weaving cloth, then organizing.
只 (zhī) matches the sound; the same part is in 职 zhí and 识 shí.
土 (earth) — ground and land: 地, 场, 块; city walls were made of earth.
成 (chéng) sounds exactly like 城; also in 诚 chéng and 盛 chéng.
木 (wood) — trees and wooden things: 树, 桌, 桥; 板 is a plank or board.
反 (fǎn) is a near sound match (-an); same part in 饭 fàn and 版 bǎn.
合 (join) — a lid fitting over an opening 口: things that fit together. 合 also appears in 答 dá, 给 gěi and 拾 shí.
女 (woman) — women and family: 妈, 姐, 奶, 姑; 婆 is an old woman or grandmother.
波 (bō) gives the sound (pó); same part in 坡 pō and 玻 bō.
石 (stone) — stones and minerals: 破 break, 码 code, 砖 brick, 磨 grind; 研 first meant to grind.
开 (kāi) stands in for old 幵 (jiān); today only a loose sound clue for yán.
穴 (cave, hole) — holes and hollows: 空, 窗, 突; digging into a cave is investigating to the bottom.
九 (jiǔ) sounds exactly like 究 jiū.
阝 (mound, left-side form of 阜 hill) — hills and places: 院, 阳, 陆; 附 is to lean against, to attach.
付 (fù) is an exact sound match; also in 府 fǔ and 符 fú.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 情, 快, 怕; 性 is the inner nature of a thing.
生 (shēng) is a loose sound hint; also in 姓 xìng and 星 xīng.
心 (heart) — feelings: 想, 思, 感, 爱; 恋 is to love or long for.
The sound part is traditional 戀 (luán), replaced in 恋 by 亦 (yì) only for simplicity — a loose clue for liàn.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 推; 扰 is to stir up and disturb.
尤 (yóu) is only a loose sound hint for rǎo.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 给, 组; 线 is thread or line.
戋 (jiān) is a loose sound clue; same part in 浅 qiǎn, 钱 qián and 残 cán.
糸 (thread, traditional of 纟) — silk and cord: 紧 tight, 系 tie; 索 is a twisted rope, seen in 线索 clue.
女 (woman) — female relatives: 妈, 姐, 姑; 妹 is a younger sister.
未 (wèi) is close to mèi; also in 味 wèi.
罒 (net, form of 网) — nets and catching: 罗, 罚, 罪; 置 first meant to set a net, then to place.
直 (zhí) is a near sound match for zhì; same part in 值 zhí and 植 zhí.
⺼ (flesh, form of 月) — body parts: 肚 belly, 脚 foot, 脸 face, 胖 fat; 脑 is the brain.
The right half shows hair over a skull and also sounds out 恼 nǎo and 瑙 nǎo.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 像 resemble; 似 is to look like.
以 (yǐ) is only a loose sound hint for sì.
乎 (hū) — as a sound part it gives hū to 呼 (call out, breathe out), so 呼 and 乎 sound the same.
令 (order) — a person kneeling under a command from above. Its sound spreads to 冷 lěng, 零 líng, 铃 líng, 领 lǐng and 怜 lián.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 提 is to lift or carry in the hand.
是 (shì) is a loose sound hint; the same part is in 题 tí and 堤 dī.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 供 is to supply or offer.
共 (gòng) sounds the same except tone; also in 恭 gōng and 洪 hóng.
女 (woman) — traditional reading shows an axe-like weapon 戌 over a woman 女, hence power and authority; compare 姑 and 妈.
⺼ (flesh, form of 月) — body parts: 脑, 脚, 肚; 胁 first meant the ribs or flank.
办 (bàn) is only a stand-in for old 劦 (xié), the real sound part; same series 协 xié.
口 (mouth) — speaking, shouting: 叫, 吗, 喊; 号 is to call out, then a call-sign or number.
丂 (kǎo) is only a loose clue; it also appears in 考 kǎo and 巧 qiǎo.
石 (stone) — stones and minerals: 破, 研, 砖; 码 first meant stone weights, then numbers.
马 (mǎ) sounds exactly like 码; also in 吗, 骂 mà, 妈 mā.
刂 (knife) — cutting and blades: 利, 别, 到; 剩 is what remains after cutting.
乘 (chéng) is close to shèng; also in 盛 shèng.
享 (enjoy) — a picture of an ancestral hall where offerings were shared, hence to enjoy; it also appears in 亨 hēng and 郭 guō.
戈 (halberd, weapon) — war and weapons: 我, 成, 武, 伐; here fighting.
占 (zhàn) sounds exactly like 战; also in 站 zhàn and 粘 zhān.
争 (contend) — simplified from 爭, two hands pulling at the same object. See 战争 war and 竞争 compete.
心 (heart; bottom form ⺗) — feelings: 想, 思, 感; 恭 is a respectful heart.
共 (gòng) gives the sound, same except tone; also in 供 gōng and 洪 hóng.
口 (mouth) — sound and speech: 吗, 叫, 喊; 响 is a sound or echo.
向 (xiàng) matches the sound except tone; also in 饷 xiǎng.
禾 (grain) — crops and harvests: 秋 autumn, 种 plant, 秒 second; 利 shows grain 禾 cut with a blade 刂, hence profit and sharp.
⻊ (foot, form of 足) — feet and walking: 跑, 跳, 路; 踪 is a footprint or trace.
宗 (zōng) sounds exactly like 踪; also in 综 zōng and 棕 zōng.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and teaching: 说, 请, 课; 训 is instruction.
川 (chuān) is only a loose sound hint; 训 shares its part with 顺 shùn.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 给, 线; 练 first meant boiling silk to soften it, then practice.
柬 (jiǎn) is a loose sound clue; same part in 炼 liàn and 简 jiǎn.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 值 is worth.
直 (zhí) sounds exactly like 值; also 植 zhí and 置 zhì.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metals and money: 钱, 铁, 钢; 银 is silver.
艮 (gèn) is only a loose sound hint; the same part is in 根 gēn and 眼 yǎn.
心 (heart) — feelings: 想, 思, 感, 怕; 恐 is fear.
巩 (gǒng) is a near sound match (-ong).
